verdict.rationale: Temporal documents durable agent loops that call LLMs and tools, and an OpenAI Agents SDK integration. However, nothing in the evidence shows Temporal itself acting as an MCP client or letting users plug in MCP servers to use their tools. Generic tool calling via Activities is a developer building block, not this capability, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
